## Description

The owner attests a dentist the same way as a doctor (P1-065), but the authority list offers the Dental Council of India and the state dental councils (India) and the dental licence of DHA, DOH or MOHAP (UAE). The role Dentist gets the doctor's clinical capabilities.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] **AC1.** A dentist can be added with a dental council registration number, authority and expiry; the medical-only authorities are not required.
- [ ] **AC2.** The prescription and signed note print the dental registration number and authority.
- [ ] **AC3.** Licence expiry reminders (P1-010) cover dental licences.
- [ ] **AC4.** Server-side authorisation tests prove a Dentist has the same clinical access as a Doctor and no more.
